reviews.name: Shaba J.
reviews.text:
I visited Hazratgunj Restaurant first time on Saturday. Good atmosphere friendly staff specially Exe Chef Akram becoz he suggested me food according to my taste. Paneer Tikka Lababdar, Aaloo Dum Banarsi,Biji ki Dal Makhni were Amazing full of taste and masaledaar Gosht was awsome. Must visit Restaurant and I thank Hazratgunj team specially Chef Akram and service team.
Second time also same taste same quality of food best restaurant in gorkhpur

reviews.name: Vaibhav K.
reviews.text: The Fish Lahori Tikka was perfectly spiced and tender, while the Hazratganj Ghost Biryani was rich, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. Cozy ambiance and excellent service made the experience even better. Highly recommend!
